outcome: success rate of induction of labor
cohort: The study included 261 high-risk nulliparous women with unfavorable Bishop Score who underwent induction of labor.
finding: Dinoprostone-first induction of labor resulted in a significantly shorter time to delivery (26.82h vs. 47.4h) compared to Foley balloon-first induction, with similar Cesarean section rates and no maternal-fetal side effects.
mod_finding: The Cesarean section rate was similar between the dinoprostone and Foley groups, but women who underwent Cesarean section had a significantly higher Body Mass Index (BMI) than women who had a vaginal delivery.
